source_independence: Expected results authored from user request and plan wording, not copied from code. Same session had inspected source before freeze: independent blind-Designer execution remains UNVERIFIED.
mock_boundary: CAD/Host deliberately synthetic; no actual Autodesk or GSA Job/Run execution

scenarios.why_a_user_does_this: Needs one CAD change and wants success only after the command finishes
criteria: one requested CAD write, no duplicate
success confirmed only after host acknowledges
scenarios.positive: single authorized CAD child; one success ACK; DONE after confirmation
scenarios.negative: host failure yields FAIL; zero asserted saved success

scenarios.persona: Engineer returns to a created result
scenarios.why_a_user_does_this: Creates and runs a task, then saves and later reopens work
criteria: ordered effects and saved revision only on acknowledged save
failure of save is not reported as saved
scenarios.positive: create, run, save each acknowledge in order; persisted state can be reopened
scenarios.negative: save failure leaves no saved-complete claim; reconnection does not invent persistence

scenarios.why_a_user_does_this: Repeats an uncertain action while another chat is manipulating the same drawing
scenarios.entrypoint: One click plus repeated request and interleaved second-chat action
criteria: one root action must not cause accidental second CAD child
independent SYSTEM work may overlap CAD
duplicate callbacks do not duplicate effects
scenarios.positive: CAD active maximum 1; intentional second-chat CAD waits; independent SYSTEM progresses; duplicate command id ignored
scenarios.negative: injected double-spawn is detected even if queue serializes; injected concurrent CAD is detected

scenarios.persona: Engineer loses connection during a command
scenarios.why_a_user_does_this: Cancels, closes and reconnects, then retries with old and new state
scenarios.entrypoint: Malformed request; active request cancel/close/reconnect; late ACK; stale planning revision
criteria: invalid/stale requests never launch CAD writes
cancel/close settles request and blocks late callback
new session can issue another command without stranded lease
scenarios.positive: invalid and stale blocked; late completion ignored; new valid request succeeds
scenarios.negative: injected late-ACK acceptance or stale-revision bypass is detected

evidence_rules: Mock PASS does not mean AutoCAD/Revit native PASS
Frozen design block never revised from implementation behavior
Test double has explicit injected-bug negative controls
Always identify root, child, callback, queue, wait-for, persistence and terminal state
